packageRules.description: On lts/* branches, only raise vulnerability/security-fix PRs; all other (non-security) updates are disabled. vulnerabilityAlerts always bypass this 'enabled: false' rule.
Disable updates to pinned Python interpreter versions (e.g. .python-version files); connectors intentionally pin specific Python versions and should not be bumped automatically
Disable dependency updates for specific connectors; deps still show on the Dependency Dashboard but no PRs are raised (vulnerabilityAlerts still bypass this)
Disable updates to pinned Python interpreter versions
Disable python-version bumps for actions/setup-python 'uses-with' steps in GitHub Actions workflows; packageName differs from depName here so matchPackageNames alone doesn't catch it (see PR #7721)
Prioritize PyPI minor updates and cap concurrent PRs to limit noise, without affecting minor updates from other datasources (Docker, GitHub Actions, etc.)

Prioritize pycti updates and raise them as soon as a new release is detected, bypassing the default schedule and repo-wide PR concurrency cap. Automerge is off by default here; flip it to true to auto-merge passing pycti PRs

Group lint, formatting and test tooling (PyPI packages and the matching pre-commit hooks) into a single PR per base branch to cut noise. Hooks are grouped with their PyPI twin so the pre-commit version stays aligned with the one used in CI. semanticCommitType is forced to chore because flake8 sits in runtime requirements files, which would otherwise make the group prefix fix or chore depending on which upgrade comes first. vulnerabilityAlerts keep their own PRs (groupName is null there).

Group pytest plugins and other test-only tooling into a single PR per base branch. The /^pytest-/ pattern covers future plugins; pytest-mock is excluded because it already belongs to the 'lint and test tools' group (a later rule would otherwise silently steal it). semanticCommitType is forced to chore for a stable group prefix.
Group GitHub Actions updates into a single PR per base branch; they only affect CI, never the shipped connectors.
